scope: Actual EVY FastAPI action dispatcher on central host to durable HTTP inbox to unchanged Rust action and six-axis MuJoCo simulator on distinct edge host. Deterministic behaviors; no training.
acceptance: Distinct Kubernetes node UID and systemUUID; observed GenuineIntel cpuinfo; RHEL container and Red Hat CoreOS node identity
Only pinned HTTPS endpoints and operator-provisioned signing approval; no request paths or commands
Durable inbox before acknowledgement; changed ID reuse rejected; no repeated execution on terminal retry
Inspection and rework capabilities through same gateway and Rust profile
Publisher and EVY connection outage after observed edge control progress; failed reconnect from edge during outage; edge completes pinned release without network dependency
Executor killed during observed progress; durable interruption; explicit Rust recover; new deliberate action succeeds
Reject unauthorized, wrong capability/digest, malformed request; no promotion of nonterminal/fake receipt
Independent SQLite and substep trace audit; reject mutated proof inputs
Retain all failed attempts, source/binary/environment identities, cleaned owned namespace confirmation
